intro: Count Remington Ridgewell is a wealthy human aristocrat found in the Petitioner's Chamber within Stormwind Keep. As a member of the House of Nobles, he prides himself on curating the finest private collection of rare historical artifacts, heirlooms, and fine art in the kingdom.

p: Remington Ridgewell represents the elite tastes of the House of Nobles, taking immense pride in his family's personal museum of jewelry and artifacts. Rather than concerning himself with military campaigns or local uprisings, the Count spends his considerable wealth acquiring relics from fallen civilizations and fallen houses across Azeroth. To expand his prestigious gallery, he finances daring adventurers and employs field agents such as Mayara Brightwing, dispatching them to retrieve priceless oddities from perilous ruins, from the mountain redoubts of Alterac to the volcanic wastes of the Burning Steppes.
